questions.q: what is the maximum amount of strain experienced by the vanadium pentoxide material
questions.rag_answer: Less than 2% elastic prestrain; DFT strains up to ±2% (acsnano.7b02404).
questions.reference: the RAG answer: <2% elastic prestrain (and ±2% in DFT), acsnano-7b02404

questions.q: Is battery passport really possible in India
questions.rag_answer: Describes the Battery Identity Global Passport (BIGP); needs global adoption; challenges (proprietary data, standardization); sources don't discuss India; possible if aligned with global standards (mattod.2020.09.001).
questions.reference: no India-specific statement; the BIGP concept and its stated conditions/challenges, mattod-2020

questions.q: can ethylene glycol and polyethylene glycol mixture be used to extract critical materials from magnets
questions.reference: not reported (EG is used in cssc-2020 to delaminate cathodes, not magnets)

questions.q: can we make lithium free cathodes for batteries?
questions.rag_answer: Cobalt-free yes, lithium-free not covered in the corpus (aenm, adma, ensm-2021).
questions.reference: Co-free cathodes yes. Lithium-free: the RAG said not covered; note the corpus has two sodium-battery papers (nanolett) whose cathodes contain no lithium
